item.title: Pointing to Ananda
item.description:
Pointing to Ananda Atagrasin

Source: TW

Author: Atagrasin

The author of this essay has published the book ‘Despertando a la Claridad’ (only available in Spanish).

See his website (Spanish) or email him (English!) at k1c2@hotmail.com.

Q: Do you exist?
A: It is obvious and evident that I exist; denying it will imply that I must exist to deny it.

Note: Here we are pointing at the ‘sat’ aspect = beingness.

Q: How do you know that you exist?
A: Simply, I know it. I exist and I know that I exist.
